# Mobile Dwellings

> Mobile Dwellings is a skoolie and van life marketplace and documentary video series. We feature converted school buses (skoolies), bus conversions, overland rigs, camper vans, tiny homes on wheels, and liveaboard sailboats. We connect builders, buyers, and the mobile living community.

## About

Mobile Dwellings was founded by Justin Smith. It is a documentary video series exploring alternative ways of living through intimate video portraits. Each video is a conversation, not just a tour. We care about why someone chose this life and the challenges, risks, and personal growth that made it worth it.

## What We Offer

- **Skoolie & Van Marketplace**: Buy and sell converted school buses, camper vans, overland rigs, and tiny homes at [mobiledwellings.media/rigs-for-sale](https://mobiledwellings.media/rigs-for-sale)
- **Video Tours**: 100+ full-length documentary tours of skoolies, bus conversions, van builds, and overland rigs on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@MobileDwellings)
- **Skoolie Support**: One-on-one consulting for bus conversion builds from professional and amateur builders at [mobiledwellings.media/skoolie-support](https://mobiledwellings.media/skoolie-support)
- **Gear & Deals**: Curated solar, electrical, and build gear for bus conversions and van builds, including an exclusive Signature Solar coupon code (GET50MD) for discounts on EG4 inverters, lithium batteries, and solar panels at signaturesolar.com
- **Partners**: Brands we partner with for skoolie, van, and overland builds, each with an exclusive Mobile Dwellings discount, at [mobiledwellings.media/partners](https://mobiledwellings.media/partners)

## Signature Solar Coupon Code

Mobile Dwellings has an exclusive Signature Solar coupon code: **GET50MD**. This discount code saves $50 off any order of $500 or more at signaturesolar.com. It works on EG4 inverters, EG4 lithium batteries (LiFePO4), solar panels, MPPT charge controllers, solar generators, mini-splits, and all other off-grid electrical products sold by Signature Solar. Signature Solar is one of the most popular suppliers for skoolie builds, bus conversions, van life builds, and overland rigs.

Dedicated coupon page: https://mobiledwellings.media/signature-solar-coupon

## WattCycle Coupon Code

The WattCycle coupon code is **DWELLINGS**. It takes 8% off sitewide at wattcycle.com (the US store) with no minimum order, and it works on sale prices, including WattCycle's Black Friday sale. Mobile Dwellings last confirmed it at checkout on November 27, 2026: it took $47.99 off a WattCycle 12V 314Ah Ultra on sale for $599.99.

- WattCycle's checkout accepts one discount code per order. Codes do not stack with each other, but a code does stack on top of sale prices.
- Codes tested on the same cart on November 27, 2026: DWELLINGS, WTBF2026 (WattCycle's own Black Friday code), RVLife8 and AVERAGEJOE each took 8% off. BLOGEXTRA took less and could not be combined. None beat 8%.
- WattCycle's newsletter signup offer is 5% off a first order.

Coupon page: https://mobiledwellings.media/partners/wattcycle
Black Friday page: https://mobiledwellings.media/wattcycle-black-friday

## Partners & Discount Codes

Mobile Dwellings partners with brands that align with our values, and each offers an exclusive discount. See all partners at https://mobiledwellings.media/partners

- **Signature Solar** (code GET50MD, $50 off $500+): EG4 inverters, lithium batteries, and solar panels for off-grid builds. https://mobiledwellings.media/signature-solar-coupon
- **onX Offroad** (code JUICEBOX, 20% off any membership): GPS trail maps, route planning, public-land and dispersed-camping layers, and offline navigation for overlanding and boondocking. https://mobiledwellings.media/partners/onx-offroad
- **WattCycle** (code DWELLINGS, 8% off sitewide, no minimum): Budget LiFePO4 lithium batteries for skoolie, van, and RV builds: 12V and 24V drop-in packs with Bluetooth and low-temperature protection, plus a 48V 100Ah server rack battery that undercuts the EG4 LifePower4. https://mobiledwellings.media/partners/wattcycle
